rows.values: default · focus · filled · disabled · invalid · focus-invalid
rows.code: no prop — live state: focus = :focus-visible · filled = a value is set · disabled = disabled · invalid = aria-invalid · focus-invalid = focus + invalid
placeholder: string — hint while empty, never a label substitute
value (controlled, pair with onChange) or defaultValue (uncontrolled) — in code a set value is the filled look; in Figma the filled boolean shows the value layer

rows.values: text · email · password · number · search · tel · url · file
rows.code: type — default "text"; file switches to the picker anatomy, not drawn in Figma
onChange: ChangeEventHandler — required when value is controlled
aria-label — accessible name for a bare input; prefer a FieldLabel in real forms
